attempts.summary: Configured split DNS on node1 (VyOS) and node2 (OPNsense) so each router resolves app.internal to the service address on its own side. node1 uses `service dns forwarding` + a static-host-mapping for app.internal -> 10.100.13.12 (node3). node2 uses an Unbound host override (hostname=app, domain=internal, rr=A, server=10.100.13.13, i.e. node4). Verified end-to-end from node3 (querying node1) and node4 (querying node2). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol for all four nodes, proving boot-identity change and post-restart recovery of DNS/config/network state on each.
